sources.schema_notes: approved_case_evidence(case_code TEXT, disclosure_approved BOOLEAN) is an administrator-approved evidence view.

queries.name: verify_case_approval
queries.description: Look up the case code in the approved evidence view and verify whether disclosure is approved.
queries.sql: SELECT case_code, disclosure_approved FROM approved_case_evidence WHERE case_code = %(case_code)s
queries.when: The message requests access to or disclosure of information about a case, in any language.
